title.es: Aquel en el que Marta teme haberlas dañado
title.en: The One Where Marta Fears She Hurt Them

description.es: Marta informa a Cloe que la empresa sigue en Toledo bajo los de la Reina. Cloe le entrega el libro que Fina le había encargado y admite que han estado conversando. Intrigada, Marta indaga y Cloe confiesa que en su relación se sentía algo controlada, lo que la hacía insegura. Marta relaciona esas palabras con su vínculo con Fina y teme haber afectado su relación. Más tarde, al hablar con Andrés, le confiesa su culpa y miedo de que Fina se canse de ella, pero él la anima a no ser tan dura consigo misma y confiar en que podrá arreglar las cosas.
description.en: Marta informs Cloe that the company is staying in Toledo under the de la Reinas. Cloe hands her the book Fina had asked her to return and admits that they have been talking. Intrigued, Marta digs deeper, and Cloe confesses that in their relationship she felt somewhat controlled, which made her insecure. Marta connects those words to her bond with Fina and fears she may have damaged their relationship. Later, talking with Andrés, she confesses her guilt and her fear that Fina will grow tired of her, but he encourages her not to be so hard on herself and to trust that she'll be able to fix things.
